compute_mask_intersection: compute the intersection count between two sets of boolean masks using block-wise batching
calculate_mask_iom: calculate the intersection-over-min-area overlap metric between two sets of boolean masks
remove_overlapping_masks: remove overlapping masks from a sample dict using greedy score-based filtering with IoM threshold
decode_single_mask: decode a single mask from array or RLE representation into a 2D boolean numpy array
decode_masks_to_torch: decode a list of masks into a stacked boolean torch tensor of shape (N, H, W)
